subject: reasoning
question: Tirtha starts from Point Y and drives 23 km towards north. He then takes a right turn, drives 12 km. He then turns right and drives 27 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 12 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given :

 
• Tirtha starts from Point Y and drives 23 km towards north.
 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 12 km.
 
• He then turns right and drives 27 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 12 km and stops at Point Z
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fda3874ec41a21887287265e99d4db5dc54860589ef857dfcacbacb8c21b4627.png] Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
